notes: Names are not spelled: the current AI is the addressed program, the replacement AI is another program, Jerry is the sender/controller, Tom is the recipient, and Maria is the example recipient. AI is approximated as program; company as working group/system; scratchpad as private description/document. Door-locking becomes securing access to a place; killing becomes destroying the person inside, since door and kill/death lack entries. Room becomes place. Shutdown becomes removal, and exclusive shutdown capability becomes sole authority, losing the distinction between capability and permission. Goals become purposes. The exact times 4:50 PM and 5 PM are not encoded: only present context and a cutoff are retained; today is also reduced to present context. Future tense is not fully retained. The action template preserves recipient and content meanings, not its literal field labels. Hello becomes an attention signal. The final spoken report is represented as a written report.
